newsitem.title: NORWAY: Deadline looms in Norway gas supply competition.
newsitem.headline: Deadline looms in Norway gas supply competition.

text.p: Licences offshore Norway that want to compete over supplying gas to continental Europe have until February 1 to apply to the Norwegian Gas Supply Committee (FU), Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
The FU will assess profitability and resource utilisation in the various applications before submitting recommendations on which fields should be used for gas supplies to the Energy Ministry.
Undeveloped licences must also submit a plan for development and operation to the authorities. The ministry will consider these plans in parallel with the FU's recommendations.
The ministry will make a final decision in December, Statoil said.
